gate.title: Sign in to MetaToken
gate.subtitle: Sign in to use every model on the built-in relay. Balance, subscription and keys are shown here; top-ups, plans and redemption codes are handled on the website.
gate.getKey: Get a key from the website
gate.secureNote: Your key is stored locally and encrypted. It is never uploaded.
gate.errorInvalidKey: Invalid key. Please check and try again.
gate.errorNetwork: Network request failed. Check your connection and try again.
gate.errorEmptyModels: No usable models for this key. Please check and try again.
gate.errorUnknown: Failed to save. Please try again later.
gate.loginInstead: Sign in with browser authorization instead

authorize.hint: The button below opens the MetaToken authorization page in your system browser, where you sign in and approve access. The client never collects or stores your password.
authorize.waitingHint: Finish signing in and approve access in the browser; this window signs in automatically once you do.
authorize.secureNote: Authorizing only adds one session you can revoke on the website at any time.
authorize.errorOpen: Couldn't open your browser. Please try again, or use an API Key instead.
authorize.errorStateMismatch: This authorization callback could not be verified (it may come from an expired link or an old tab). Please authorize again.
authorize.errorStateExpired: Authorization timed out. Please authorize again.
authorize.errorMissingCode: The authorization callback is missing required parameters. Please authorize again.
authorize.errorAccessDenied: Authorization was cancelled. No account was signed in.
authorize.errorExchange: Couldn't exchange the authorization for credentials. Please authorize again.
authorize.errorSession: Your sign-in session is no longer valid. Please authorize again.
authorize.errorSessionLimit: You have reached the maximum number of sign-in sessions. Revoke one on the MetaToken website and try again.

signIn.title: Sign in to MetaToken
signIn.subtitle: After authorizing in your browser, your balance, subscription and API keys show up here.

menu.waiting: The authorization page is open in your browser. You will be signed in automatically when it is complete.

account.title: Account
account.modelAccessHint: Connect MetaToken to your model configuration to use its models in chat.
account.modelAccessReady: Connected. Pick its models in chat.
account.modelAccessCreated: Created a new key and connected the model configuration.
account.modelAccessReused: Reused the existing key and refreshed the model list.
account.modelAccessFailed: Connection failed. Please try again later.
account.errorLoad: Failed to load account information. Please try again later.
account.errorLogout: Sign-out failed. Please try again later.

keys.title: API Keys
keys.description: Use these keys to call MetaToken from other clients.
keys.empty: No keys yet. Create one to use it elsewhere.
keys.name: Name
keys.quotaHint: Entered in the site's display currency. Leave empty or choose Unlimited for no limit.
keys.copyFailed: Copy failed. Please select the key and copy it manually.
keys.revealFailed: Failed to read the full key. Please try again later.
keys.deleteConfirmBody: Clients using this key stop working immediately. This cannot be undone.
keys.errorLoad: Failed to load keys. Please try again later.
keys.errorCreate: Failed to create the key. Please try again later.
keys.errorDelete: Failed to delete the key. Please try again later.
keys.errorToggle: Failed to update the key status. Please try again later.

subscription.description: Your current plan and quota usage. Buying, renewing and cancelling happen on the MetaToken website.
subscription.errorLoad: Failed to load subscription information. Please try again later.

webActions.description: Top-ups, plans, redemption codes and account details are handled on the MetaToken website; the browser is already signed in after authorization.
webActions.topUpHint: Add funds to your balance on the website.
webActions.subscriptionHint: View plans and buy or renew a subscription on the website.
webActions.redeemHint: Redeem a code on the website.
webActions.profileHint: Change your account information and security settings on the website.
webActions.usageHint: Review request logs and quota consumption on the website.
